title: Notes on learning in public
summary: A short placeholder about sharing the questions and discoveries that come with learning something new.

content.content:
## Start with a question

This second dummy post shows how articles appear in date order and how Markdown headings and links can be used in the body.

A useful note does not need to be a complete guide. Sometimes it is enough to explain what you tried, what surprised you and what you would do differently next time.

## Keep it useful

The best posts are specific and honest about what happened. Replace this sample copy with your own writing before publishing the site.
